words.en: If you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.ex: He is a handsome boy.
words.ex_cn: 他是个英俊的男孩。
words.en: A handsome man is good-looking, usually in a way that is attractive to women. Something that is handsome is large in quantity or impressive in quality.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.ex: The firefighter is a hero for saving the child.
words.ex_cn: 消防员救了孩子，是个英雄。
words.en: A hero is a person who is admired for their courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.

words.tr:
v. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；抨击；达到；
n. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；(演出等)成功；
words.ex: He hit the ball with a bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒打了球。
words.en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

words.ex: She put jam on her bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐在面包上涂了果酱。
words.en: Jam is a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar until it is thick. It is usually spread on bread or toast. Jam can also refer to a situation where things are crowded or blocked, or the act of forcing something into a tight space.

words.tr:
v. 跳；跳跃；
n. 跳；跳跃；
words.ex: The boy jump over the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 男孩跳过了水坑。
words.en: To push oneself off a surface and into the air by using the muscles in one's legs and feet; to move quickly and suddenly.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: The kid is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小孩在玩球。
words.en: A kid is a child or young person. As a verb, to kid means to tease or deceive someone in a playful way.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.ex_cn: 他有一所大房子。
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.tr: n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
words.ex: Hard labor helps build strong character.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动有助于培养坚强的品格。
words.en: Work, especially physical work; to work hard.

words.tr:
n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
v. 辛勤工作；
words.ex: Hard labour helps people build strong skills.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动帮助人们培养强大的技能。
words.en: Labour is very hard work, especially physical work. It can also refer to the workers of a country or industry, considered as a group, or the process of childbirth.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.tr:
n. 大师；主人；
v. 掌握；精通；
words.ex: He is a master of classical piano.
words.ex_cn: 他是古典钢琴的大师。
words.en: A master is someone who has control over something or someone; a person who is highly skilled in a particular area; or a degree awarded by a university or college.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我等了五分钟。
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: The moon shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 月亮在夜空中明亮地照耀。
words.en: The natural satellite of the earth, visible (chiefly at night) by reflected light from the sun.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服了药。
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: He eats a nut every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗坚果当早餐。
words.en: A nut is a fruit consisting of a hard or tough shell around an edible kernel. It is also a metal block with a threaded hole that is used with a bolt to fasten things together. Informally, it can refer to someone who is crazy or eccentric.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.ex: The dinosaur lived in a long period ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙生活在很久以前的一个时期。
words.en: A period is a length of time in which something happens, or a stretch of time with a particular quality or characteristic.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.tr:
n. 平原；
adj. 简单明了的；朴素的；
words.ex: The cows graze on the plain.
words.ex_cn: 牛在平原上吃草。
words.en: If something is plain, it is easy to see, hear, or understand.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很好。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.tr:
n. 赛跑；竞争；种族；
v. 比赛；快速移动；
words.ex: He won the race by running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快速奔跑赢得了赛跑。
words.en: A race is a competition to see who is the fastest, for example in running, swimming, or driving.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: The children played on the shore of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖岸玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天花朵盛开。
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 眼泪；泪水；
v. 撕裂；撕开；
words.ex: A tear fell down her cheek when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个消息时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滑落。
words.en: A tear is a drop of clear salty liquid that is produced by the glands in your eyes when you cry or when your eyes are irritated.

words.ex: The child plays with a toy car.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩一辆玩具汽车。
words.en: A toy is an object for children to play with.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 come

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr: phrase. v. （观点或态度）改变，回心转意；顺便来访，顺道拜访；苏醒，恢复知觉
words.ex: At first he refused, but later he came around and agreed to help.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始拒绝了，但后来回心转意，同意帮忙。
words.en: To change one's opinion or decision; to regain consciousness; to visit someone casually.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （观点或态度）转变，改变主意；（身体或情绪上）恢复；顺便来访，过来
words.ex: He didn't want to help at first, but he came round after we talked.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始不想帮忙，但经过交谈后改变了主意。
words.en: To regain consciousness; to change one's opinion or position; to visit someone casually.

words.tr: phrase. v. 获得；设法得到；顺道来访
words.ex: I came by some old books at the flea market.
words.ex_cn: 我在跳蚤市场弄到了一些旧书。
words.en: To obtain or acquire something, especially something that is not easily available.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 下来；下降；流传；病倒
words.ex: The price of apples came down last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周苹果的价格降了。
words.en: To move or travel from a higher to a lower level or position; to descend.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 受到（批评、赞扬等）；招致
words.ex: He came in for criticism after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因这个错误而受到了批评。
words.en: If someone or something comes in for criticism, blame, or praise, they receive it.

words.ex: The company came into being in 2010.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司成立于2010年。
words.en: To begin to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；举行；实现；成功；从…掉下
words.ex: He will come off the train at the next station.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下一站下车。
words.en: To happen or occur, especially in a particular way; to be successful or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 加油；快点；拜托；来吧；开始
words.ex: Come on, you can finish this race!
words.ex_cn: 加油，你能跑完这场比赛的！
words.en: Used to encourage someone to do something or to hurry up, or to express disbelief or skepticism.

words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；显现；实现；成功地完成；（健康）恢复；渡过
words.ex: The package will come through tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 包裹明天会到达。
words.en: To successfully deal with a difficult situation or to do what is needed or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 面对；遭遇（困难、反对等）
words.ex: He came up against a big problem while solving the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时遇到了一个大问题。
words.en: To encounter or face difficulties or opposition.

words.ex: The temperature came up to 30 degrees yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度升到了30度。
words.en: To reach a particular standard or level; to be as good as expected.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 go

words.tr: phrase. 着手干；进行；（经常）表现得
words.ex: He goes about his work quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地做自己的工作。
words.en: If you go about a task or problem in a particular way, you start dealing with it in that way.

words.ex: He goes after his dreams every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天追求自己的梦想。
words.en: To pursue or chase someone or something, often with the intention of catching or achieving them.

words.ex: If you go against the rules, you might get in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规定，可能会惹上麻烦。
words.en: To oppose or act in contradiction to something or someone.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 前进； 进行；赞同
words.ex: The car went along the road slowly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓慢地沿着路前进。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something, especially a plan or activity; to agree with or support an idea, proposal, etc.

words.tr: 参观; 转动; 走访; 相处
words.ex: We went around the old town last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们参观了老城区。
words.en: If you go around to someone's house, you visit them. If a story or piece of information goes around, it is told or passed on to a lot of people. If there is enough of something to go around, there is enough for everyone to have some.

words.tr: phrase. 到处走动；流传；供应
words.ex: The children go round the park every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午到处在公园里走动。
words.en: To move from place to place or to be sufficient for everyone.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 向…扑去；攻击；着手处理
words.ex: The dog went at the mailman with barking.
words.ex_cn: 那只狗朝邮递员扑了过去。
words.en: To attack or to start doing something with energy.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；追求；努力争取
words.ex: I want to go for the blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我对那件蓝色的衬衫感兴趣。
words.en: If you go for something, you choose it or try to achieve it.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；爱好；从事；赞成
words.ex: He goes in for football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加足球。
words.en: To participate in or be involved with something; to have a liking for something.

words.ex: He goes into the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To enter a place, to start doing something as a job or activity, to investigate or examine something, or to discuss something in detail.

words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持完成；贯彻到底；把…进行到底（尤指困难或不愉快的事）
words.ex: He decided to go through with the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他决定坚持执行这个计划。
words.en: To complete or carry out something, especially something that is difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 沉没；死；屈服；失败；破产
words.ex: The boat went under after hitting the rock.
words.ex_cn: 船撞上岩石后沉没了。
words.en: To fail, collapse, or be defeated; to sink or submerge.

words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.tr: phrase. 伴随；与...相配；同…一致
words.ex: I will go with you to the market.
words.ex_cn: 我会和你一起去市场。
words.en: To be suitable or appropriate with something; to accompany something; to exist or occur together with something.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 break

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；（使）逐渐适用
words.ex: Thieves broke in through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从后门闯入。
words.en: To enter a building by force, especially in order to steal something; to interrupt a conversation or activity.

words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.ex: He broke through the wall with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手打破了墙壁。
words.en: To break through means to make a way through a barrier or to achieve success in spite of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 call

words.ex: He received a callback after the interview.
words.ex_cn: 面试后他收到了回叫信号。
words.en: A callback is a telephone call that you make to someone who has called you, or a function that is passed as an argument to another function and is executed after some event has occurred.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 叫（某人）进来；召来；来访
words.ex: He called in a doctor for his sick son.
words.ex_cn: 他为生病的儿子请了一位医生。
words.en: To request someone's presence or participation, especially by telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call upon my grandmother this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我会去拜访我的祖母。
words.en: To call upon someone is to ask them to do something or to use something that they can offer.

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 bring

words.ex: He brought his friend around to the new idea slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地让朋友接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To persuade someone to agree with you or to do what you want; to cause someone to regain consciousness; to cause someone to change their opinion or decision.

words.ex: He brought round his friend to agree with him.
words.ex_cn: 他说服了他的朋友同意他的观点。
words.en: To cause someone to become conscious again after being unconscious; to persuade someone to agree with a particular opinion or to do something.

words.ex: The new policy will bring down prices.
words.ex_cn: 新政策将降低价格。
words.en: To cause something to fall or collapse; to reduce the level or amount of something; to cause someone in a position of power to lose their position.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；产生；生出；使显现
words.ex: He brought forth a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To bring forth means to produce or cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 把…拿进来；介绍引进；赚（钱）
words.ex: Can you bring in the books from the car?
words.ex_cn: 你能把车里的书拿进来吗？
words.en: To introduce something new or to cause something to happen.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功完成（困难的事情）；使（计划、交易等）成功
words.ex: He brought off the magic show with great skill.
words.ex_cn: 他以高超的技巧完成了这场魔术表演。
words.en: To successfully achieve something difficult.

words.ex: The heat can bring on a headache.
words.ex_cn: 炎热会引发头痛。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to lead to a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 使表现出；说出；呈出；出版
words.ex: The new lighting really brings out the colors in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 新灯光让画中的颜色更加突出。
words.en: To cause something to be seen or known; to publish something.

words.ex: The nurse poured cold water on his face to bring him to.
words.ex_cn: 护士往他脸上泼了冷水，让他苏醒过来。
words.en: To cause someone to regain consciousness or to become aware of something.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 do

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.tr: phrase. 对...有效；适于；代替；替…理家
words.ex: This medicine does for his cough.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对他的咳嗽有效。
words.en: To be suitable or adequate for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 扣好；整理好；修缮；包装
words.ex: She will do up her dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她会把裙子整理好去参加派对。
words.en: To fasten, close, or tidy something, or to repair or renovate it.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相处；忍受；处理；与…有关；需要；想做
words.ex: I don't know how to do with him; he is always quiet.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么和他相处；他总是很安静。
words.en: To have a connection or relevance to a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: We can do without sugar in our coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我们咖啡里可以不加糖。
words.en: To manage or survive without something that one would like to have.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 get

words.tr: phrasal verb. （消息等）传开；（人）走动，外出活动
words.ex: The news about the party got about quickly.
words.ex_cn: 关于派对的消息很快传开了。
words.en: To move around or travel, especially within a community or area.

words.ex: He tried to get across his idea simply.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简单地表达他的想法。
words.en: To succeed in communicating an idea or piece of information to someone, especially when this is difficult or complicated.

words.tr: phrase. v. 取得成功；进步；超越他人
words.ex: He works hard to get ahead in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以在工作中取得进步。
words.en: To make progress or become successful in one's career or life.

words.ex: They get along well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们相处得很好。
words.en: If people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

words.ex: The thief tried to get away from the police.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图逃脱警察。
words.en: If you get away, you succeed in leaving a place or a person's company. If you get away with something, you succeed in doing it without being caught or punished.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；取回；恢复；报复
words.ex: He will get back tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会回来。
words.en: To return to a place, condition, or activity; to recover something lost or taken away; to retaliate.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；到达；插话；收割；当选
words.ex: He gets in the car every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上车。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a journey.

words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.ex: He told the dog to get out.
words.ex_cn: 他让狗出去。
words.en: To leave or escape from a place or situation.

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 make

words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: Composed or formed by combining various elements or parts.

words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something is made up of particular things or people, it consists of those things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 特意做；认为…很重要；总是要做（某事）；坚持要
words.ex: He makes a point of exercising every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天早上锻炼。
words.en: If you make a point of doing something, you do it in a very deliberate way, often to show that you think it is important.

words.tr: phrase. 假装；假扮；幻想 n. 假装；虚构的事
words.ex: The children like to make believe they are pirates.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢假装他们是海盗。
words.en: To pretend or imagine that something is true or real, especially as a game or for entertainment.

words.ex: He made for the door when he heard the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他听到警报后走向了门。
words.en: If something makes for a particular situation, it causes that situation to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 及时到达；达到预定目标
words.ex: We need to leave now to make it to the train on time.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在必须出发，才能及时赶到火车。
words.en: To succeed in arriving at a place or achieving a goal.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；看待；解释（某事）
words.ex: I don't make of what he said.
words.ex_cn: 我不理解他所说的话。
words.en: To interpret or understand something in a particular way.

words.ex: He made off after stealing the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他偷了自行车后就离开了。
words.en: To leave quickly, especially in order to escape or avoid something; to steal something and leave quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；费力前进；取得成功；闯出一条路
words.ex: The boy makes his way to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上步行去上学。
words.en: To move or travel towards a destination, especially when this is difficult or takes a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 讲和；和解；休战；达成和平协议
words.ex: They make peace after a long fight.
words.ex_cn: 他们在长时间争吵后和好了。
words.en: To end a conflict or hostilities and establish friendly relations.

words.tr: phrase. 取得进步；取得进展
words.ex: He is making progress in his English speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语口语方面正在取得进步。
words.en: To advance or develop towards a better, more complete, or more modern state.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.ex: He made up his mind to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: The crowd made way for the ambulance.
words.ex_cn: 人群为救护车让路。
words.en: To move aside or to allow someone or something to pass by.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 carry

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功地处理或应对（困难或尴尬的情况）；夺走；使显得有魅力
words.ex: He carried off the awkward silence with a joke.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个笑话成功应对了尴尬的沉默。
words.en: To succeed in doing or achieving something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.ex: We can carry over the unused vacation days to next year.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把未用完的假期天数延到明年。
words.en: To transfer or extend something from one time or place to another.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持到底；完成；帮助某人渡过难关
words.ex: He worked hard to carry through his plan.
words.ex_cn: 他努力实施他的计划。
words.en: To complete something or to continue doing something until it is finished, especially something difficult.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 catch

words.tr: phrase. v. 试图抓住；急切地抓住（机会、希望等）
words.ex: He tried to catch at the rope as it slipped away.
words.ex_cn: 当绳子滑走时，他试图抓住它。
words.en: To try to seize or grasp something eagerly.

words.ex: The paper caught fire quickly.
words.ex_cn: 纸很快着火了。
words.en: To begin to burn; to ignite.

words.ex: He tries to catch hold of the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住那根绳子。
words.en: To grasp or seize something, especially something that is moving or difficult to grasp.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使某人措手不及；发现某人做错事；使某人陷入困境
words.ex: The teacher's question caught me out because I didn't study.
words.ex_cn: 老师的问题让我措手不及，因为我没学习。
words.en: To discover someone doing something wrong or making a mistake, especially when they are trying to deceive you.

words.ex: I caught sight of a bird flying over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看见一只鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: If you catch sight of someone or something, you see them suddenly or briefly.

words.ex: He ran fast to catch up with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便追上他的朋友。
words.en: To reach someone or something that is ahead of you, or to make up for lost time or progress.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 cut

words.ex: He wants to cut back on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, cost, etc. of something.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 插嘴；打断；超车抢档
words.ex: He cut in while I was talking.
words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.ex: He cut out sugar from his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他从饮食中戒掉了糖。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it or to stop doing something.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 keep

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；隐瞒；留在后面
words.ex: He tried to keep back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To retain or withhold something, not allowing it to be seen, known, or used.

words.ex: Please keep down the noise.
words.ex_cn: 请把噪音压低。
words.en: To prevent something from increasing, spreading, or becoming too noticeable.

words.ex: He tried to keep from crying.
words.ex_cn: 他努力忍住不哭。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to not do something oneself.

words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.ex: Keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 别踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid touching, stepping on, or coming into contact with something; to prevent someone or something from coming near or touching something.

words.ex: He keeps on walking even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使累了，他还是继续走。
words.en: If you keep on doing something, you continue to do it and do not stop.

words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.ex: He keeps to his schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都遵守自己的日程。
words.en: To continue to do something or to stay in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 take

words.ex: He takes after his father in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在长相上像他父亲。
words.en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

words.ex: He will take along his lunch to school.
words.ex_cn: 他将会带上他的午餐去学校。
words.en: To bring someone or something with you when you go somewhere.

words.ex: He took apart the clock to see how it works.
words.ex_cn: 他把钟表拆开来看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into its different parts, especially in order to repair it or to understand how it works.

words.ex: He takes away the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具拿走。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to subtract a number or amount from another.

words.tr: phrase. 拿回；收回；取消；使回忆起
words.ex: I will take back my book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我会从图书馆拿回我的书。
words.en: To take something back means to return something to the place it came from, or to admit that something you said was wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸；拆毁；记录；记下；笔录；取下
words.ex: He took down the old photo from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧照片取了下来。
words.en: To write something down, especially in order to remember or record it; to remove something from a high position; to dismantle or disassemble something.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.tr: phrase. 开始从事；喜欢；形成...的习惯
words.ex: He took to swimming every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他开始每天早上游泳来保持健康。
words.en: To begin to like someone or something; to start doing something as a habit or regular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: I take him as my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他当作我最好的朋友。
words.en: To regard or consider something in a particular way.

words.ex: Don't take him for a fool; he's very smart.
words.ex_cn: 不要把他当成傻瓜；他非常聪明。
words.en: To consider someone or something to be a particular type of person or thing, especially when this is wrong.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 put

words.tr: phrase. 使被理解；把…讲清楚；成功地表达（想法、观点等）
words.ex: He tried to put across his idea clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他试图清楚地表达他的想法。
words.en: To communicate something clearly and effectively to someone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使被理解；成功传达（想法、信息等）；推迟；延期
words.ex: He put over the message clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地传达了那个信息。
words.en: To successfully communicate an idea or message to someone, or to postpone something to a later time.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；记下；镇压；贬低；削减；杀死
words.ex: He put down his pen and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 他放下笔，笑了。
words.en: To place something on a surface or in a particular position; to write something down; to suppress or end something by force; to criticize someone in a way that makes them seem stupid or unimportant.

words.ex: He put forward a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To suggest or propose something for consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 提出申请；提交请求；正式要求（某物或某职位）
words.ex: He put in for a vacation next month.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了下个月的假期。
words.en: If you put in for something, you formally request or apply for it, such as a job, promotion, or leave.

words.tr: phrase. 放进；插入；提出；提交；使就职；进港
words.ex: Put in the keys before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前把钥匙放进去。
words.en: To place something inside or into a particular position or location.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；付诸实践；把…应用到实践中
words.ex: He learned to put his new skills into practice at work.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了在工作中把新技能付诸实践。
words.en: To apply or implement something in a real situation.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 扑灭；熄掉；伸出；发表；恼怒
words.ex: He put out the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他用毯子扑灭了火。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or light; to publish or produce something; to extend or stretch out something.

words.ex: He was put through a tough training program.
words.ex_cn: 他经受了一项严格的训练计划。
words.en: To cause someone to experience something, especially something difficult or unpleasant, or to connect a telephone call.

words.ex: He learned English and put it to use in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他学了英语，并在工作中加以运用。
words.en: To use something for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 look

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 向前看；为将来打算
words.ex: We need to look ahead and plan for the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要展望未来并为将来做计划。
words.en: To think about what will happen in the future and plan for it.

words.ex: He looks back on his childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他满怀幸福地回忆自己的童年。
words.en: To look back means to think about something that happened in the past.

words.ex: He looks down on people who work hard.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起努力工作的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.ex: Some people look down upon others who have less money.
words.ex_cn: 有些人瞧不起那些钱少的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: I will look in on my grandma after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去看望我奶奶。
words.en: To make a brief visit or inspection.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.tr: phrase. 观看；面向；旁观；看待
words.ex: They look on while the children play.
words.ex_cn: 他们看着孩子们玩耍。
words.en: To watch something happen without getting involved.

words.ex: Look out the window to see the birds.
words.ex_cn: 往窗外看，看看那些鸟。
words.en: To be vigilant or cautious.

words.tr: phrase. 当心；留心；寻找；照料
words.ex: Look out for the dog when you walk by.
words.ex_cn: 你经过时要当心那只狗。
words.en: To be vigilant or attentive; to watch for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.ex: You must look to your health before it's too late.
words.ex_cn: 你必须注意你的健康，趁还来得及。
words.en: To expect or depend on someone or something to do something or provide something.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 show

words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 带领参观；引导四处看看
words.ex: He will show around the visitors at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他将带参观者在学校里转转。
words.en: To lead someone on a tour of a place, showing them its features and facilities.

words.ex: He gave a shout out to his mom during the speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中公开感谢了他的妈妈。
words.en: To shout out means to say something in a very loud voice or to publicly thank or praise someone.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 set

words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 反对；与…相对；以…为背景
words.ex: He set against the new policy because it hurt the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新政策，因为它伤害了穷人。
words.en: If you set one thing against another, you consider it in relation to another thing, especially in order to show how they are different or to decide which is better.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；留出；使与众不同
words.ex: His kindness sets him apart from others.
words.ex_cn: 他的善良使他与众不同。
words.en: To distinguish someone or something as different from others; to reserve or allocate something for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 阻碍；延缓；使受挫折；回拨（钟表）
words.ex: The storm set back the construction by two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴把施工推迟了两周。
words.en: To delay or hinder the progress of something.

words.tr: phrase. 制定；（使）放下；（叫…）下车；记下
words.ex: The government set down new rules for safety.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了新的安全规则。
words.en: To place something on a surface or to write or record something officially.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；提出；陈列；出发；把…提前
words.ex: He set forth his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地提出了自己的想法。
words.en: To present or introduce something, such as an idea, plan, or argument, in a clear and detailed way.

words.ex: The rain set in after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后雨开始下了。
words.en: If something sets in, especially something unpleasant, it begins and seems likely to continue or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.ex: The dog set on the intruder.
words.ex_cn: 狗攻击了入侵者。
words.en: To cause someone or something to attack or confront someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

chapters.name: 附录3 常考动词短语 see

words.tr: phrase. v. 处理；安排；照料（某事）
words.ex: I will see about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 我会去确认一下会议时间。
words.en: To attend to or deal with something.

words.ex: We went to the station to see off our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们去车站为朋友送行。
words.en: To accompany someone to the point of departure, such as an airport, train station, etc., as a gesture of farewell.

words.tr: phrase. v. 送某人到门口；陪伴某人至结束；完成（某事）
words.ex: I will see you out after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我会送你到门口。
words.en: To continue with a task or project until it is completed, despite difficulties or the time it takes; to accompany someone to the door when they are leaving.

words.ex: I can see through his lie.
words.ex_cn: 我看穿了他的谎言。
words.en: To perceive the true nature of someone or something, especially their deceitfulness or the real situation. Also, to support someone or something until the end of a difficult situation.

words.ex: I will see to the children while you are away.
words.ex_cn: 你不在的时候，我会照看孩子们。
words.en: To attend to or take care of something.
